name: NSeoulMascot
intendedUse: real-time browser mascot with walk and wave animations

formRefinement.shirt: elliptical multi-ring shell following the torso instead of a rigid cylinder
formRefinement.limbs: single plush volumes with hidden elbow and knee joints
formRefinement.seams: raised elliptical collar and hem cords
formRefinement.surface: subtle generated micro-bump; no photo lighting baked into albedo

surfacePass.shirtProfile: centripetal Catmull-Rom interpolation across a dense elliptical ring profile
surfacePass.sleeves: rounded plush volumes overlapping the arm and shirt to hide hard joints
surfacePass.lowerBody: closer hip pivots and wider leg volumes reduce the pointed center gap
surfacePass.jointContinuity: stationary shoulder gussets overlap the moving sleeve volumes
surfacePass.footContact: root height compensates for leg swing while the airborne foot receives an explicit lift
surfacePass.waveArc: the raised arm oscillates in the front-visible shoulder plane
surfacePass.ears: torus rims and recessed inner volumes replace stacked spheres
surfacePass.eyes: separate catchlight geometry improves the plush character expression
surfacePass.tail: a raised circular root seam clarifies the rear attachment

detailFidelity.logo: reduced tube radius and extrusion depth read as a printed/embroidered mark instead of a rigid badge
detailFidelity.stitches: instanced stitch dashes follow the elliptical collar and hem with two draw calls

inferenceNotes: The shirt-hidden torso is inferred from the four neutral views.
Knee and elbow joints are intentionally omitted to preserve the plush silhouette.
The under view is used for paw layout, not global proportion measurement.
